A small republic in Central Europe. Electricity is scarce, the Halvek border is watched, and the Ministry of National Security keeps an eye on every citizen.
Inspecteur de 3e classe, premier jour à: Inspector, 3rd class, first day at Section 4. Your father, a clockmaker, disappeared in 1971. The Ministry recruited you anyway. Or perhaps for that very reason.
Chaque jour, des dossiers de citoyens si: Every day, files on citizens who have been reported. Read the documents, note what matters, and look for two items that do not say the same thing: that is a contradiction.
Une journée de service dure huit heures,: A working day lasts eight hours, from 08h00 to 16h00. Reading a document, noting it, comparing two items: that is free. But interrogating, searching a home, requesting an archive or consulting your superior costs hours. You can pull up to two hours of overtime — at the cost of your evening. You cannot do everything on every file: choosing where to dig is already a decision.
Vous signez ensuite une conclusion. Derr: You then sign a conclusion. Behind every file there is someone: an archive will show you their fate — transferred, released, deported — and sometimes a line from their family. Choosing well means weighing the evidence AND what it costs a human being. The VERITAS system will advise you. It is not always right.
